units.source_text: 三公主自幼学弹七弦琴，但她很小就离家于归六条院，

en.t: The Third Princess had learned to play the seven-stringed zither from childhood, but while still very young she left home and married into the Rokujo estate,

units.source_text: 朱雀院不知她现在学得如何了，很是挂念。

en.t: and Suzaku-in, not knowing how well she had progressed by now, was deeply concerned.

units.source_text: 他对左右说道：“公主归宁时，我想叫她弹七弦琴给我听呢。

en.t: He said to those around him, "When the princess comes home for a visit, I should like to have her play the seven-stringed zither for me.

units.source_text: 她在那边，这琴定然学得很好了吧。”

en.t: Over there, she must surely have become quite skilled at it."

units.source_text: 这话传入宫中，皇上听到了，说道：“是啊，她一定学得特别好了。

en.t: When this remark reached the palace, the Emperor heard it and said, "Yes, she must certainly have become especially accomplished.

units.source_text: 她在父皇面前献技时，我也想去听听呢。”

en.t: When she displays her skill before her father, I too would like to go and listen."

units.source_text: 这话又传入源氏耳中，他说：“近几年来，每逢适当机会，我总教她弹琴。

en.t: This in turn reached Genji's ears, and he said, "In recent years, whenever a suitable occasion arose, I have always taught her the zither.

units.source_text: 她的技术确已进步得多了。

en.t: Her technique has indeed improved a great deal.

units.source_text: 然而还不曾学会值得欣赏的精深手法。

en.t: Yet she has not yet mastered the refined methods that would truly be worth admiring.

units.source_text: 如果毫无准备前去参见上皇，而上皇命她弹奏、不许推却时，她难免困窘吧。”

en.t: If she were to go before the Retired Emperor with no preparation, and he ordered her to play and would not let her decline, she would surely be embarrassed."

units.source_text: 他替三公主担心，从此时起，便悉心教练。

en.t: Worried for the Third Princess, he began from that time on to instruct her with the greatest care.
